messages:
anna_finance: Heads-up: we're launching a new billing behavior next quarter. Two items: (1) legacy free-credit top-ups will be retired with a conversion to a one-time account voucher and (2) we're introducing an elastic burst-credit window (15m) to reduce invoice noise from short spikes. Full plan below.

billing-bot: Summary: free-credit retirement + elastic_burst_credit_window. Opt-in pilot starts 2026-05-01; staged default later in Q2.

carmen_support: What will customers see on invoices and in Console? We should prepare clear copy.

anna_finance: Invoices will show "Voucher conversion" when credits are turned into vouchers and a separate "Burst-credit smoothing" line when the elastic window adjusts billing. Console -> Billing will include a preview tool so customers can simulate conversion.

raj_prod: Any API/runtime signals to surface? New headers or events?

anna_finance: Runtime will emit X-Redwood-ElasticBurst and X-Redwood-VoucherPreview headers. Meter events: elastic_burst_applied, voucher_converted. Add dashboards under Billing -> Elastic metrics.

eli_sre: I'll add smoke tests for headers and an alert if smoothing adjustments exceed 30% for top-tier accounts.

carmen_support: I'll draft KB + canned replies and post for review by 2026-04-21. Escalations use prefix [Billing-Voucher].

sam_ceo: Good plan. Make the first month after any global flip opt-out and send proactive notices to high-usage customers.

anna_finance: Rollout: 2026-05-01 opt-in pilot; 2026-06-01 default for new Hosted accounts; 2026-07-01 rolling default for legacy Hosted with 30-day opt-out. Dedicated accounts are not auto-migrated.

anna_finance: Action items: support KB (carmen_support by 2026-04-21), runtime headers/events & dashboards (eli_sre by 2026-04-24), sales outreach list (sales ops by 2026-04-22), finance to update invoice template (anna_finance by 2026-05-01).

billing-bot: Internal doc: https://redwood.example/internal/billing/elastic-burst. KB draft: https://redwood.example/drafts/billing/voucher-conversion. End of thread.
